design.mood: Industrial-modern and professional with a warm, high-contrast energetic backdrop.
design.centerpiece: Monochromatic orange industrial landscape with a semi-floating white card footer.
guardrails: Do not use sharp 90-degree corners on the footer container.
Avoid heavy drop shadows; use subtle elevation or none at all.
Don't use color for link text; keep secondary text in neutral grays.
Avoid crowded link columns; prioritize breathable white space.
design.motion: Staggered fade-in for link columns. The background image should employ a subtle parallax scroll or a slow zoom-in scale effect. Social icons use a slight lift on hover.

typography.mono: IBM Plex Mono, Medium (for uppercase labels)

design.layout: A two-tiered floating card with a horizontal divider. The top tier features a 4-column grid (Logo followed by 3 link columns), and the bottom tier contains legal copyright and a right-aligned social icon row.
